title: Party Z and its leadership
body:
Read the following account of an imaginary party and answer the question.

Party Z was founded thirty years ago by a popular leader. It has not held elections to its organisational posts for fifteen years and keeps no register of its members. The party president alone decides who will get tickets, and members who question his decisions are removed from their posts. Ordinary workers say they hear about major decisions only from the newspapers. When the president retired last year, his daughter, who had never held any party post or contested an election, was made the new president. Several senior workers who had served the party for decades left in protest. In the last election, tickets went mostly to candidates who could pay for their own campaigns.
